def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if 5 in row]
    cols = [c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if any(grid[r][c] == 5 for r in range(len(grid)))]
    top, bottom = min(rows), max(rows)
    left, right = min(cols), max(cols)

    layer = 1
    while bottom - top + 1 > 5 and right - left + 1 > 5:
        t, b = top + layer, bottom - layer
        l, r = left + layer, right - layer
        color = 2 if layer % 2 else 5
        for c in range(l, r + 1):
            out[t][c] = color
            out[b][c] = color
        for rr in range(t, b + 1):
            out[rr][l] = color
            out[rr][r] = color
        layer += 1
    return out

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if 5 in grid[r]]

    top, bottom = min(rows), max(rows)

    H, W = bottom - top + 1, right - left + 1

    # Alternating rings; stop with a 3x3 empty center for odd frames,
    # or fill the final 2x2 ring for even frames.
    max_layer = min((H - 1) // 2, (W - 1) // 2)

        color = 2 if layer % 2 else 5
        for c in range(l, r + 1):
            out[t][c] = color
            out[b][c] = color
        for rr in range(t, b + 1):
            out[rr][l] = color
            out[rr][r] = color
    return out
